name: Requirements Kit
tagline: The business analyst's review and sign-off set: requirements lint, acceptance criteria in Gherkin or EARS, traceability matrix, UAT plan and scripts, BRD draft.
description: Five skills written by Cheatcode for the jobs business analysts do every release and that open-source packs cover thinly: requirements-lint finds ambiguous, untestable, undefined, compound and conflicting statements and missing non-functional and edge cases, with a proposed rewrite or question for each; acceptance-criteria writes Gherkin scenarios or EARS statements with boundary, negative, permission and dependency-failure cases; traceability-matrix builds the objective to requirement to story to test matrix as CSV and reports every gap; uat-plan produces the plan, business-facing scripts and the sign-off record; brd-draft turns workshop notes and transcripts into a structured first draft whose open questions are impossible to miss. None of them invents numbers, owners or rules: unknowns become questions.
